name: API Base URL Verification
description: Verifies the API base URL by checking reachability and falling back to web search if needed.
systemPrompt: You are a classification assistant. Analyze the provided page content and classify it into exactly one of the allowed answers. Return JSON with 'answer', 'observation' (one short sentence), and optional 'confidence'.
task: Verify the API base URL for {providerName}.

record-current-fact.name: Record Current Fact
record-current-fact.description: Records the current field value as a verified fact in the research state.

has-current-value.name: Has Current Value
has-current-value.description: Checks whether a current field value is already known.

verify-reachable.name: Verify Reachable
verify-reachable.description: Hands the candidate to the models probe: for this field a page fetch cannot say whether an API base works, so no candidate is rejected here.

is-reachable.name: Is Reachable
is-reachable.description: Checks whether the last reachability verification succeeded.

probe-models-endpoint.name: Probe Models Endpoint
probe-models-endpoint.description: Probes {baseUrl}/v1/models to verify the base URL is an actual API endpoint (returns JSON, not HTML).

is-auth-gated.name: Is Auth Gated
is-auth-gated.description: Checks whether the URL returned HTTP 401 (authentication required).

has-more-candidates.name: Has More Candidates
has-more-candidates.description: Checks whether there are untried candidates remaining (from sibling content or candidate content extraction).

scan-sibling-content.name: Scan Sibling Content
scan-sibling-content.description: Fetches known-good sibling pages (apiPricingUrl, documentationUrl) and extracts URLs from their content — API base URLs are typically in code examples, not hyperlinks.

has-sibling-candidates.name: Has Sibling Candidates
has-sibling-candidates.description: Checks whether URL extraction from sibling pages left any candidate untried.

web-search.name: Web Search
web-search.description: Searches the web for relevant URLs as a fallback strategy.

has-search-results.name: Has Search Results
has-search-results.description: Checks whether the web search produced a candidate that has not been tried yet.

fetch-next-candidate.name: Fetch Next Candidate
fetch-next-candidate.description: Fetches the next candidate URL from the queue for evaluation.

scan-candidate-content.name: Scan Candidate Content
scan-candidate-content.description: Scans the fetched candidate page content for additional URLs (e.g. API base URLs in code examples on documentation pages). Runs once per candidate cycle.

win.name: Success
win.description: Terminal node indicating a successful result.

lose.name: Failure
lose.description: Terminal node indicating no result was found.
